title: Sebastian and the Safehouse
author: F. M. Thackeray
blurb: Noor Ravensworth, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
